# Ezvor

> Free interview-prep and career platform: 3,900+ coding problems with a verified in-app judge (Python and JavaScript run in the browser; C++ and Java on free cloud runners), curated study lists (Blind 75, NeetCode 150, Grind 75), an AI coach, progress tracking with spaced repetition, roadmaps, live opportunities and an AI career advisor.

## Pages
- [Home](/): Dashboard, daily challenge, streak, reviews due.
- [Problems](/problems): Full catalog with topic, company and list filters.
- [Problem page](/problems/two-sum): Editor, Run/Submit, editorial, verified solutions, AI coach, notes.
- [Study Lists](/lists): Blind 75, NeetCode 150, Grind 75 with pattern roadmaps.
- [Progress](/progress): Activity heatmap, streaks, topic mastery, review queue.
- [Leaderboard](/leaderboard): Public profiles ranked by solved problems.
- [Compiler](/compiler): Online IDE for 13 languages with shareable links.
- [Roadmaps](/roadmaps): Skill graphs and AI-personalised learning paths.
- [Opportunities](/opportunities): Live jobs, programs, contests and fellowships.
- [AI Advisor](/advisor): Career advisor chat.
